For children aged 16-19, Child Benefit can only continue if they are in approved education or training. Since this information is unknown, I cannot definitively determine if you're eligible for Child Benefit for Alex.

**To resolve this:** You would need to confirm whether Alex is currently enrolled in approved education or training. If yes, you would likely be eligible. If no, you would not be eligible.

Since Blake has started an apprenticeship in England, this automatically disqualifies you from receiving Child Benefit for Blake, even though Blake lives with you and is under 21.

---
